question: When the controller target is authenticated at t4 but two physically held commands have lost action intent, can task-consistent delayed-intent compensation generate new task trajectories with higher success than fixed-readback and continuously informed comparator?
task_used_in_prior_algorithm_development: PushCube single native controller-target geometry witness in earlier research; NOT used for 32-state frozen-PPO task-level performance or delayed-intent replay choice; not a never-before-mentioned task

method_frozen_before_outcomes.history: save only frozen PPO own public desired-native arm normalized 6D commands during two known fault steps without reading real hidden target
method_frozen_before_outcomes.readback: one explicit actual target_pose read after two holds at source step=4, same as corrected fixed policy
method_frozen_before_outcomes.alignment_candidate: 0.5 times the sum of two held source translational normalized deltas, projected onto the current trusted readback-adjusted native translation direction; if mismatched do not inject
method_frozen_before_outcomes.safe_action_contract: clip root-native translational normalized coordinates to [-1,1]; never add Euler rotation commands; gripper unchanged; action entirely generated from public source policy history plus counted fixed target read
method_frozen_before_outcomes.unconditional_control: same gain and same held source translation average but without positive alignment gate; true distinct physically executed baseline

primary_metric: full-denominator official task success across 32 independent seed clusters; no test-time threshold tuning
success_gate: new aligned method strictly more successes than BOTH corrected fixed readback AND continuous true-target oracle, with no more decision private reads than fixed (32); hard negative otherwise
secondary: full native action trace divergence on at least 1 reset
unsaturated fraction, changes and refuse reasons
scientific_limits: mechanistic nonlearned intervention; does not constitute novel dissertation algorithm by itself
information_firewall: All post hoc true target reads are audit only; online method reads the controller target once at t4 exactly like fixed baseline. Never use test success, fault truth or privileged oracle stream to choose new replay action.
negative_reporting: retain ALL failures, unexposed faults, interrupted and incomplete original resets; do not reclassify a broken run as positive.
